title: 2016 AMC 8 Problem 2
statement: In rectangle \(ABCD,\) \(AB=6\) and \(AD=8.\) Point \(M\) is the midpoint of \(\overline{AD}.\) What is the area of \(\triangle AMC?\)

solutions.text:
Since \(M\) is the midpoint of \(\overline{AD},\) the base \(AM\) has length \(4.\) The altitude from \(C\) to \(\overline{AM}\) has length \(AB=6.\) The area is therefore \(\dfrac{1}{2} \cdot 4 \cdot 6 = 12.\)

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Since \(M\) is the midpoint of \(\overline{AD}\), find \(AM\).
Use \(AM\) as the base and the rectangle’s vertical side length as the height.
